subject: Implementation timeline & SOW revision request — Beacon Health
messages:
From: Alicia Ramos <aramos@beaconhealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>; laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tnguyen@beaconhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: SOW update + implementation window request

Hi Jonas / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about Redwood's dedicated model routing and caching features. We're ready to move forward but need a couple of SOW edits captured before procurement will sign:

- Add a 4-week migration window in the SOW (week-of 2027-02-07 preferred).
- Include explicit acceptance criteria for throughput (95th pctl latency < 200ms for 2k RPS tests).
- Expand the Order Form to show a temporary +25% burst capacity for the first 90 days and the associated price uplift.

I'm attaching a marked-up draft (Beacon_SOW_v2_marked.pdf) with inline comments. Can you confirm whether the burst capacity will require a separate onboarding fee and whether Redwood Legal is comfortable with the proposed rollback clause on page 6?

We'd like to get this into DocuSign by end of month to hit our Jan timeline. Proposed contacts for redlines: me (procurement) and Tom (platform lead).

Best,
Alicia Ramos
Senior Procurement Manager
Beacon Health Systems

Attachments: Beacon_SOW_v2_marked.pdf

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <aramos@beaconhealth.com>; Tom Nguyen <tnguyen@beaconhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOW update + implementation window request

Alicia — thanks for the clear markup and timeline. Appreciate the specificity; that helps. Quick points and next steps from our side: 

- Migration window: we can support the week of 2027-02-07. I'll have our PM (cc'd Laura) draft a cutover plan with daily checkpoints and rollback criteria.
- Acceptance criteria: we can put the 95th percentile latency target into the SOW, but want to add test parameters (payload mix, request sizes) for repeatability.
- Burst capacity: technical yes — the platform supports a +25% short-term burst. There is typically a one-time provisioning fee for guaranteed burst capacity; Karthik, are you able to propose numbers?
- Rollback clause: Markus, can Legal review the proposed language on page 6 and advise on risk/alternative wording?

Proposed timeline: Legal redlines by 2026-12-22 -> PM cutover plan by 2026-12-21 -> Pricing/orderform update by 2026-12-20 -> DocuSign envelope created 2026-12-28. If that looks tight, we can push the signature target to 2027-01-07.

I'll capture these in a short summary and upload to the shared Drive.

Thanks — Jonas
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference

Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 08:32:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: SOW update + implementation window request — pricing note

Alicia / Jonas —

Thanks for the markup. Quick pricing note so procurement has a number to work with:

- Baseline order form (as last discussed): $180,000 / month for committed capacity.
- Temporary +25% burst capacity (first 90 days): one-time provisioning fee $28,500 plus an uplift of 15% on the monthly rate during the 90-day burst.
- One-time onboarding support (3 FTE-days): $7,200 — we can apply a $4,000 credit if Beacon signs within 14 days of receiving the final order form.

I'll attach an updated order form workbook with line-item math (orderform_BH_v3.xlsx). Jonas — confirm whether we should include the provisioning fee as a separate line or roll it into the onboarding line for cleaner procurement approval.

DocuSign: once Legal signs off on the rollback and acceptance wording, I'll prepare a final Order Form + SOW package and request signature routing.

—Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Ramos <aramos@beaconhealth.com>, Tom Nguyen <tnguyen@beaconhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 15:42:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: SOW update + implementation window request — next steps

Markus / Laura —

Thanks Karthik and Alicia for iterating fast here. Markus, can you please run a quick legal pass on the attached redlines_summary.docx and specifically: 

1) Assess whether the rollback clause (page 6 in the Beacon_SOW_v2_marked.pdf) exposes Redwood to material prime-contractor liability. If so, propose alternative language that limits liability to direct damages and defines a narrow rollback trigger.
2) Confirm whether the acceptance criteria wording should include test harness details (we prefer to reference an attached test plan rather than bake long specs into the SOW).
3) Check the indemnity carve-outs for third-party model components (Beacon asked to add an exception; we should avoid broad indemnities).

If Legal can sign off by 2026-12-22, Karthik will finalize pricing and I'll get the PM cutover plan uploaded to the shared Drive for Beacon to review. Laura — please prepare a 1-page cutover checklist (rollback steps, communication cadence, exec escalation path) by 2026-12-21.

Alicia / Tom — thanks for the clarity; we'll come back with a consolidated redline set and a single orderform file for signature. If you prefer, we can also schedule a 30-minute legal sync on Tuesday the 22nd.

Next steps summary:
- Legal review complete: target 2026-12-22 (Markus)
- PM cutover checklist: 2026-12-21 (Laura)
- Final Order Form + SOW: 2026-12-20 (Karthik)
- DocuSign routing: 2026-12-28 (Karthik/Jonas)

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
